QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] Welcome to Eluna Prime
QuestInfo.0: The moment you disembark the Express ship to Eluna Prime, a voice calls out to you. Talk to #p9400461#.
QuestInfo.1: #p9400461# is the leader of the prospectors seeking out their fortune on Eluna Prime. He's offered to teach you the basics of prospecting. You should take him up on that!\r\n\r\n#b#eNote:#n If you have any questions while prospecting on Eluna, talk to #p9400461# to read through his copy of #e[Eluna - Prospecting and You]#n!
